posts.title: Jaissle starts with win, but Newcastle not planning a locker room smash
posts.excerpt: Newcastle’s Matthias Jaissle has opened with a win, but the BBC says he is not planning to ‘smash’ the locker room. What Ghana bettors should watch next.
